kjv: it grieveth me (Naomi) much for your (Orpah and Ruth's) sakes
mine: it is far more bitter for me (Naomi) than for you (Orpah and Ruth)
note: Mar-li meod mikkem: the min can be comparative ('more bitter for me than for you', since Naomi has no prospects) or causal ('bitter on your account'); the KJV takes the latter.
